pcs.pc_description: ascertain the circumstances leading to the breakdown and recent history of repairs and maintenance done on the hydraulic system of the equipment
inspect the work area and ensure it is safe and clean with adequate lighting and ventilation and as per the safety regulations, to enable repairs to be carried out efficiently
inspect the machine for visible damages /deficiencies and leaks in the hydraulic and related systems
check all levels of fuel, coolant and oils in engine, hydraulic and transmission systems; top up if necessary
start the engine as per procedure and check running to confirm the defect/fault reported in the hydraulic system
test the hydraulic and safety circuits sequentially using appropriate testing tools, aids like schematics and diagnostic equipment
test the hydraulic control systems and instrument panels sequentially using appropriate testing tools, aids like schematics and diagnostic equipment
analyze and interpret the diagnostic results to identify the fault and its most likely causes as per the manufacturers service manual
ascertain the availability of necessary parts and consumables and prepare a proposed repair plan including approximate costing and time schedule for preliminary approval as applicable
remove the affected hydraulic system parts correctly without causing further damage to them and peripheral components

inspect the removed/disassembled parts, identify those that can be reused/repaired/ replaced as applicable and finalize the work order including revised costing if necessary and obtain approval before commencing work
replace or repair the affected parts as per procedure, test functionality on bench as applicable and refit / reassemble the same as per the manufacturers guidelines
start the engine as per procedure and test running to confirm the defect/fault has been rectified and all hydraulic and related systems are working as per the laid down specifications and parameters
ascertain the applicable maintenance/service schedule and history of recent repairs and maintenance/service tasks done on the hydraulic system of the equipment
start the engine as per procedure and test running for leakages, unusual noises and general performance to corroborate with operators feedback on equipments hydraulic system
ascertain the availability of necessary parts and consumables and prepare a tentative maintenance plan including approximate costing and time schedule for approval as applicable

carry out all applicable maintenance/service tasks on the equipments hydraulic system as per manufacturers specifications and procedures; ensuring only genuine and approved parts and consumables are used
start the engine as per procedure and conduct a final test run to check the performance of hydraulic system is as per the laid down specifications and parameters
monitor and guide as necessary the junior mechanics regularly to ensure quality and safety of work being carried out
dispose the defective parts, consumables and waste as per the organizational policies & environmental regulations
complete and submit periodic/final reports and relevant documentation as per the organizational policies and procedures
